name: Safekeeping Place Format 47 Choice
definition: Choice of formats for a place of safekeeping.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Place of safekeeping expressed as a code and a narrative description.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Place of safekeeping expressed with a country code.

DigitalLedgerIdentification.name: Digital Ledger Identification
DigitalLedgerIdentification.definition: Place of settlement expressed with a Digital Ledger Identifier. It identifies a digital ledger or distributed ledger system (for example, blockchain or similar platforms).

TypeAndIdentification.name: Type And Identification
TypeAndIdentification.definition: Place of safekeeping expressed with a type and identification.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Place of safekeeping expressed with a propriety identification scheme.
